Read a scheme-less CouchDB URL as http:// in the probe and the persister

The conftest probe now reads a URL without a scheme as http:// for both
parsing and redaction, so its password stays out of the skip reason and the
named host is probed; a malformed port skips the CouchDB items with a
redacted reason instead of failing collection. CouchDbPersister built
'http//' (no colon) when inserting credentials into a scheme-less URL.

Fixes #8
